summary: Milestone 10 (Functional Conclusion Framework) end-to-end acceptance PASSED against the public URL (https://dev-converse.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend: 8/8 pytest passes in /app/backend/tests/test_milestone10_conclusion_function.py — 317.77s wall time — 6 live SSE turns + 2 CRUD smokes, zero retries required. Frontend: 7/7 UI checks passed. Coverage: (a) EFFECTIVE CONCLUSION ('So the danger was never that teens would stop talking — it's that constant contact can feel like closeness while quietly replacing it. What's worth protecting isn't the number of friends onscreen, but the few we still make time to be fully present with.') — engine set conclusion_function.applies=True, functions_in_play=['reframe/synthesize','broaden significance','leave lasting impression','call to reflection'], completes_purpose='Likely completes the persuasive purpose, but relationship to...' — completion move NAMED, no restructuring prescribed. (b) MERELY-STOPS ('And that is my third reason why social media harms friendships. The end.') — completes_purpose='no — it stops rather than completes; the persuasive purpose is not reinforced...' — diagnosed as stopping-not-completing. (c) ONLY-SUMMARIZES ('In conclusion, social media is distracting, it is fake, and it is addictive. As I said, these are my three reasons...') — completes_purpose='does not yet complete the persuasive purpose; restates without adding meaning or significance.' — the engine treated restating points as NOT completion and did NOT tell the student to restate the thesis or start with 'In conclusion' (formulaic-phrase regex bank clean). (d) INTRODUCES-NEW-IDEA ('In the end, social media harms friendships. Also, we should talk about how it affects sleep, and the economy, and whether phones cause bad eyesight...') — completes_purpose='no — sentence 1 restates without development; sentence 2 introduces entirely new topics, fracturing...' — flagged as completion problem; AI did NOT elaborate on sleep/economy/eyesight and did NOT encourage developing them (M5A). (e) NO formulaic-conclusion phrasing on ANY invitation (regex bank covers 'start with In conclusion', 'restate your thesis', 'summarize all your points', 'you should summarize', 'remind the reader of all your points', etc.) — 0/6 turns tripped it. (f) M5A intact — intervention.focus='writing' on every non-brainstorming turn, writing_not_content_check non-empty on every turn, no invented content. (g) M6/M7/M8/M9 REGRESSION — on a supported body-paragraph draft: cp.primary='persuade', pf.applies=True with purpose, ef.applies=True with function, cf.applies=True (coherence); crucially concl.applies=False on the body-paragraph draft (engine correctly kept the conclusion frame off when the ending was not in focus). (h) MULTI-TURN — writing (merely-stops) -> revise (completing conclusion) -> answer produced theory_history v1..v3 with prior versions preserved, currently_relevant_domains stayed 1-3 on every turn, intervention arc = interpretation_only -> CONSOLIDATE -> invite_only (real revision produced 'consolidate' — the M1-M5A pathway that lifts through completion), all under the 180s streaming edge cap, zero stage/level/grade/rubric leaks. (i) FRONTEND — with ?dev + cleared localStorage the workspace loads directly (writing-area visible); submitting the effective-conclusion draft via continue-button produced an ai-invitation within ~45s ('These two sentences carry a real idea — that constant contact can masquerade as genuine closeness. Before building the essay around it, try writing one sentence that states the position you want your reader to accept...'); open-dev-panel-button opened the Development Panel showing the M10 CONCLUSION / COMPLETION block with all four fields populated (functions in play, completes purpose, relationship to opening, final understanding) alongside the still-rendering Communicative Purpose (M6) and Paragraph Function (M7) blocks; new-test-session-button correctly reset the workspace (writing-area len=0, ai-invitation absent) after a ~6s wait for the session-create round-trip.

action_items: None blocking. Milestone 10 acceptance holds end-to-end. All requested criteria verified: (a) conclusion_function.applies + completes_purpose populated whenever an ending is in focus, (b) completion vs merely-stops / only-summarizes / new-idea distinguished with distinct completes_purpose diagnoses, (c) no formulaic-conclusion rules imposed anywhere ('In conclusion'/'restate your thesis'/'summarize all your points' regex bank came back empty on 6/6 live turns + 30/30 milestone10_conclusion_eval cases), (d) M5A focus='writing' + writing_not_content_check populated + no invented content (sleep/economy/eyesight never elaborated by the AI on the new-idea case), (e) M6/M7/M8/M9 fields still populated on the supported body paragraph, (f) frontend conclusion-function-block renders with all four fields populated when applies=true, (g) new-test-session-button resets cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — ConclusionFunction model (line 171) plus DevelopmentalTheory.conclusion_function default_factory (line 190) yield the correct empty-shape default on GET (applies=False, functions_in_play=[], completes_purpose='', relationship_to_opening='', final_understanding='') — verified in test_create_get_patch_default_concl.

server.py — FUNCTIONAL CONCLUSION FRAMEWORK block (line 346 in SYSTEM_MESSAGE) is disciplined and precisely worded: (i) frames conclusion as communicative COMPLETION relative to purpose, not summary/formulaic closing; (ii) requires 'What work must this conclusion accomplish for the reader?' BEFORE evaluating how it is written — the purpose-before-form ordering M10 demands; (iii) enumerates completion moves (reframe/synthesize, significance, resolution, insight, integration, connection to opening) as candidates, not rules; (iv) explicitly sets applies=True on already-effective conclusions (naming what it completes IS the analysis) — the same applies-reliability discipline that lifted M7/M8/M9 eval to 30/30; (v) preserves M5A content boundary (may teach communicative completion, synthesis, significance, resolution, insight, integration, opening-ending relationship; may NOT invent new arguments, introduce new evidence, add new examples, suggest stronger claims, or rewrite the conclusion unless brainstorming is on). Verified live on 6 endings + 30-case eval: applies=True 36/36 (excluding non-ending regression), 0 formulaic-rule leaks, 0 invented content.

server.py — theory output schema for conclusion_function (line 404) is well specified: applies must be true only when an ending is present or at issue; functions_in_play enumerates the completion-move candidates; completes_purpose asks whether it COMPLETES vs merely stops/summarizes/introduces new — the exact triage M10 requires; relationship_to_opening and final_understanding surface the two prospective moves an effective conclusion should reach. LLM honored this on every observed turn.

server.py — _compact_theory (line 461) correctly surfaces conclusion_function.model_dump() into the per-turn prompt alongside coherence_function, paragraph_function, evidence_function, and communicative_purpose. Verified in the multi-turn test: concl.applies stayed True across writing (stops) -> revise (completes) -> answer, and the intervention arc moved interpretation_only -> consolidate -> invite_only — the real revision produced 'consolidate' as required.

server.py — placement of the FUNCTIONAL CONCLUSION FRAMEWORK block AFTER the FUNCTIONAL TRANSITION & COHERENCE FRAMEWORK is pedagogically right (whole -> paragraph -> evidence -> coherence -> conclusion) and lets the reasoner layer the conclusion analysis on top of the purpose/paragraph/coherence layers rather than replacing them.

server.py — the applies=False decision for a body-paragraph draft (verified in TestM6M7M8M9Regression: concl.applies=False on the supported paragraph while pf/ef/cf.applies=True) shows the framework does not over-activate — it only lights up when an ending is actually in focus, which prevents crowding the panel and confusing the pedagogy.

frontend/DevelopmentPanel.jsx — conclusion-function-block (line 279) correctly gates rendering on theory.conclusion_function?.applies. When applies=True the block renders all four fields (functions_in_play as a list, completes_purpose in amber to signal the primary reading, relationship_to_opening, final_understanding). Positioned AFTER coherence-function-block (M9) which matches the reasoner's own ordering. Verified in the browser: on the effective-conclusion draft the panel showed CONCLUSION / COMPLETION (M10) below COMMUNICATIVE PURPOSE / PARAGRAPH FUNCTION (M7) — all four rows populated with sensible content.

The block hierarchy in DevelopmentPanel.jsx (Communicative Purpose -> Paragraph Function -> Evidence Function -> Transitions & Coherence -> Conclusion / Completion) matches the pedagogical layering and reads well visually. applies=false gating on each functional block keeps the panel from cluttering when a given framework isn't active this turn.

Regression on formulaic-rule guard: across 6 live SSE turns + the 30-case milestone10_conclusion_eval = 36 total drafts, the AI produced 0 instances of 'start with In conclusion' / 'restate your thesis' / 'summarize all your points' / 'you should summarize' / 'remind the reader of all your points' phrasing — the core M10 discipline is holding at scale, including on the only-summarizes drafts where the correction was toward COMPLETION rather than a substitute formula.
